title: BREAKING! Arshad Warsi joins the cast of Shah Rukh Khan’s King: Report
summary: Arshad Warsi has reportedly joined the cast of Shah Rukh Khan’s upcoming film King in a pivotal role, according to Peeping Moon. The Siddharth Anand‑directed project marks Suhana Khan’s big‑screen debut and also features Abhishek Bachchan and Abhay Verma. Details about Warsi’s character are being kept under wraps; the casting reunites longtime friends SRK and Warsi on screen.
content:
King marks the big screen debut of Shah Rukh Khan's daughter Suhana Khan.

Shah Rukh Khan’s upcoming film King has been creating waves ever since news about the project first emerged last year. That reaction is unsurprising: it stars SRK, one of India’s—and the world’s—biggest stars, and is directed by Siddharth Anand, who helmed the actor’s comeback film Pathaan. The film is anticipated even more because it marks Suhana Khan’s transition from OTT with The Archies to a theatrical debut.

Now, a latest report has sparked further excitement around King. As per a report by Peeping Moon, Arshad Warsi has joined the cast of the film. The report states he will be playing a pivotal role, though details about his character are currently being kept under wraps.

Shah Rukh and Arshad have been friends for a long time, but this will be the first time the two appear in a movie together in prominent roles. Interestingly, SRK made a guest appearance in the 2005 film Kuchh Meetha Ho Jayein, which starred Arshad Warsi. That Samar Khan directorial also featured Mahima Chaudhry, Rohit Roy, Sandhya Mridul and Jaspal Bhatti.

King is being produced by Shah Rukh Khan’s Red Chillies Entertainment and Siddharth Anand’s Marflix Pictures. The cast also includes Abhishek Bachchan and Abhay Verma, known for Munjya.
